channel.title: The Luverne Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Luverne Journal (luvernejournal.com)

item.title: Held hostage by hospitality
item.description: Tired of sidewalk small talk? Here’s how to set polite, clear limits with a chatty neighbor — without turning every trip to the mailbox into a 20-minute conversation.

item.title: Pate awarded nutrition school friend of the year
item.description: Alabama Agriculture Commissioner Rick Pate named ASNA Friend of the Year for leading the Farm to School Incentive Program, boosting fresh Alabama-grown foods in cafeterias statewide.

item.title: This week in history: 1996
item.description: In 1996, Luverne welcomed its first 24-hour drive-up ATM as Crenshaw Christian Academy staged a Broadway-themed Miss CCA pageant.

item.title: Willis with 2026 Samuel Boykin Medal of Excellence
item.description: University of Mobile names alumna and nursing leader Stefanie Willis the 2026 Samuel Boykin Medal of Excellence recipient for her faith-based service and impact on cancer care and nursing education.

item.title: Meadowcrest Apartments crowns king, queen
item.description: Meadowcrest Apartments crowns its first fundraising king and queen as residents Joseph Wossilek and Johnnie Pettus lead efforts to support the Alzheimer’s Association in Luverne.

item.title: Crenshaw County Arrests March 2 - 8
item.description: Crenshaw County arrest report: March 2–8 bookings include DUI, theft of property, drug-related charges, failure-to-appear cases and holds for other agencies.

item.title: What's Happening in Crenshaw County
item.description: Upcoming library programs, festivals, meetings, farm workshops, health screenings and more in Crenshaw County, plus how to submit your event to the Luverne Journal.

item.title: Miss HHS contestants to sparkle, shine Saturday
item.description: Miss HHS 2026 will be crowned March 14 at Highland Home School, as nine contestants compete in the “Dream Big, Sparkle More, Shine Bright” pageant.

item.title: Faith Community Calendar
item.description: Upcoming local faith events: food pantry, Living Last Supper services, missions meeting, appreciation dinner and first responder breakfast, plus how to submit your listing.

item.title: Alabama author's contest opens March 16
item.description: Entries open March 16 for the 2026 Alabama Author of the Year contest, open to published Alabama writers through Melissa Michelle Ministries, with video bio submissions accepted through July 16.
